description: This file contains Odoo module code defining models and methods related to timesheet invoicing, including classes for invoice rates, analytic accounts, analytic lines, timesheets, and invoices, with associated business logic.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_invoice_factor
classes.description: Model representing invoice rate factors for timesheet invoicing.

classes.name: account_analytic_account
classes.description: Model extending analytic account with invoicing and pricing details, including calculation of invoiced amounts.

classes.name: account_analytic_line
classes.description: Model extending analytic lines with invoicing references and access control to prevent modification of invoiced lines.

classes.name: hr_analytic_timesheet
classes.description: Model extending timesheets with account association and warning on pending accounts.

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Model extending invoices with logic to link analytic lines' 'to_invoice' field based on invoice type.

methods.name: _invoiced_calc
methods.description: Calculates total invoiced amount for analytic accounts.

methods.name: on_change_account_id
methods.description: Updates 'to_invoice' field and warns if account is pending when account is changed in timesheet.

methods.name: _get_analytic_lines
methods.description: Overrides to set 'to_invoice' on analytic lines for vendor bills.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Prevents modification of invoiced analytic lines.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Checks before writing to analytic lines.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Ensures analytic lines with invoices are not modified.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Overrides copy to reset invoice association.
